title: verdict.json
description: I3 — written to the repo root by the Claude Code session before it finishes. The workflow's verify step fails the run if this file is absent, malformed, or if `url` does not resolve via `gh pr view` / `gh issue view`.

action.description: What the agent produced. Anything outside this set fails the gate.

url.description: The GitHub URL of the artifact. Must resolve.

suspect_sha.description: Short SHA of the commit blamed. Omitted only when action is 'issue' and no repo-side cause was found.

metrics_flat.description: The discriminator. CPU rising while memory, disk and error rate stay flat is what rules out a leak, a full disk, and a broken dependency -- leaving "the same request now burns CPU it did not burn before", which is a code change. Names here are metric names, not the fully-qualified SEARCH labels the dispatch payload uses as evidence keys.

ruled_out.description: Other candidate commits and why each was rejected. This is what proves discrimination rather than confirmation.
